MaxPoints.Name: Maximum Fate Dice
MaxPoints.Hint: The most Fate Dice a character can hold at once.

RerollEnabled.Name: Enable Fate Reroll
RerollEnabled.Hint: Let players spend Fate Dice to roll an extra d20 after any d20 roll and keep the highest.

RerollCost.Name: Fate Reroll cost
RerollCost.Hint: How many Fate Dice a Fate Reroll costs.

BonusEnabled.Name: Enable fate die bonus
BonusEnabled.Hint: Add a bonus to a low fate die as soon as it is rolled.

BonusThreshold.Name: Fate die bonus applies on
BonusThreshold.Hint: A fate die showing this number or lower gets the bonus.

BonusAmount.Name: Fate die bonus
BonusAmount.Hint: How much is added to a low fate die.

RerollOnInitiative.Name: Allow Fate Reroll on initiative
RerollOnInitiative.Hint: Let players use a Fate Reroll on initiative rolls.

RerollOnDeathSaves.Name: Allow Fate Reroll on death saves
RerollOnDeathSaves.Hint: Let players use a Fate Reroll on death saving throws.

ShowHud.Name: Show Fate Dice HUD
ShowHud.Hint: Show your character's Fate Dice on screen (GMs: a button for the Fate Dice panel). Drag it to move it.

NominationMode.Name: Nominations
NominationMode.Hint: Let players nominate another player's character for a Fate Die, approved by the GM or by a majority vote of the players online.

NominationLimit.Name: Nominations per player per session
NominationLimit.Hint: How many nominations each player can make each session (0 for no limit).

HidePf2eHeroPointReroll.Name: Hide pf2e's Hero Point reroll
HidePf2eHeroPointReroll.Hint: Remove pf2e's "Reroll using a Hero Point" from chat cards, so players use Fate Dice instead.
